# Fifth Avenue Sushi

> Fifth Avenue Sushi is an authentic Japanese restaurant in downtown Calgary, Alberta, Canada, at 118A 5th Ave SE (T2G 0E2). Led by head Chef Mike, it serves fresh sushi, sashimi, nigiri, specialty rolls, ramen, and Japanese hot dishes for dine-in, pickup, and delivery. Rated 4.9★ on Google. Free parking is available directly behind the restaurant.

## Key facts

- Name: Fifth Avenue Sushi
- Cuisine: Japanese, sushi, sashimi, ramen
- Address: 118A 5th Ave SE, Calgary, AB T2G 0E2, Canada
- Neighbourhood: Downtown Calgary (Downtown Commercial Core)
- Phone: +1 (825) 205-9668
- Rating: 4.9★ on Google Reviews
- Hours: Monday–Friday 11:00am–9:00pm; Saturday–Sunday 12:00pm–9:00pm
- Reservations: OpenTable — https://www.opentable.com/r/fifth-avenue-sushi-calgary
- Delivery/pickup: DoorDash, plus in-house dine-in
- Parking: Free parking directly behind the restaurant
- Head chef: Chef Mike

## Reservations & ordering

- Reserve a table: https://www.opentable.com/r/fifth-avenue-sushi-calgary
- Call to book or ask questions: +1 (825) 205-9668
- Delivery and pickup: available through DoorDash

## Common questions

- What are the hours? Monday–Friday 11am–9pm, Saturday–Sunday 12pm–9pm.
- Do they take reservations? Yes — via OpenTable or by phone at (825) 205-9668.
- Do they take walk-ins? Yes, as space allows; calling ahead is recommended for larger parties or peak times.
- Is there parking? Yes — free parking directly behind the restaurant.
- Delivery or takeout? Yes — delivery and pickup through DoorDash, plus dine-in.
- Large groups or private events? Yes — inquire via the Private Dining page.
- Allergies? Advise your server when ordering and the kitchen will do its best to accommodate.
